data: What is the approximate maximum number of neurons with accuracy scores in the range of 0.55 to 0.60 in the bottom graph?

The question asks for an approximate maximum number of neurons with accuracy scores in the range of 0.55 to 0.60 in the bottom graph. The bottom graph corresponds to the histogram of DBPedia accuracy. 

To analyze this, I will look at the height of the bars within the range of 0.55 to 0.60 in the bottom graph. The tallest bar in this range appears to be around 70 neurons. Therefore, the approximate maximum number of neurons in this range is 70.
